title: List the new service-ai-studio tool list_flow_runs in PLATFORM_TOOLS_BY_PACKAGE and give it a chatbot.tool label in every locale
body:
repo:cloud#2 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbWTyRFQwYN1hZXbCHL

Filing gate: open question of a cloud lane card's report, settled by the seat (land the cloud side now, with a named debt that removes itself on the next pin bump).

## What happens

The cloud package `service-ai-studio` adds a build-agent tool, `list_flow_runs`: it reads a flow's recent runs, as the caller, so the in-app agent can answer "did my automation work?" from the run's own error. The framework does not know the name yet:

- `PLATFORM_TOOLS_BY_PACKAGE['service-ai-studio']` (the spec's platform tool-name registry, pinned by `packages/spec/src/system/constants/platform-tool-names.test.ts`) does not list it.
- `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts` has `chatbot.tool.test_flow` and `chatbot.tool.toggle_flow`, but no `chatbot.tool.list_flow_runs`. So `humanizeToolName` in `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot` falls back to the English "List flow runs" as the chat step's title, even in a Chinese chat.

## Expected

1. `list_flow_runs` is in `PLATFORM_TOOLS_BY_PACKAGE['service-ai-studio']`, beside `test_flow` and `toggle_flow`.
2. Every locale pack has `chatbot.tool.list_flow_runs`, worded like its neighbours (for example zh-Hans 「查看自动化运行记录」, en "Check automation runs").
3. The registry's own test and the locale-completeness check stay green. The cloud side's AHEAD entry for this name is deleted on the pin bump that carries this.
